objective: SoC設計を行い、CPUからLLMのキックをする

blocking_reasons: CPU is a tiny custom instruction-ROM model, not RV32 or a production CPU core.
The kicked target is a quantized KV-cache proxy, not a full tokenizer/model graph/decoder datapath.
The hybrid run is a correctness/control proof using 800 patch-script launches and does not support a serving performance claim.

candidate_next_paths.name: accept_proxy_scope_as_goal_completion
candidate_next_paths.what_it_would_mean: Treat the existing tiny instruction-ROM CPU plus quantized KV-cache proxy as satisfying CPUからLLMのキック.
required_artifacts: update docs/status.md and docs/roadmap.md to mark the scoped goal complete
keep non-claims for RV32, production CPU, full LLM inference, and speedup
candidate_next_paths.risk: This narrows LLM to the existing RTL proxy and does not prove full LLM inference.

candidate_next_paths.name: real_cpu_core_kicks_llm_proxy
candidate_next_paths.what_it_would_mean: Import or select one real CPU core as a submodule, run a tiny software image, and have that core kick the existing LLM proxy through a minimal MMIO bridge.
required_artifacts: source-selection gate for one CPU core
third_party submodule import, not vendored generated source
CPU-vs-hybrid coverage-output equivalence report for CPU-visible kick/done/output words
candidate_next_paths.risk: This expands active surface and may reintroduce large CPU-source complexity that the repo just removed.

candidate_next_paths.name: tiny_cpu_kicks_full_llm_datapath
candidate_next_paths.what_it_would_mean: Keep the tiny CPU model but replace the proxy target with a fuller LLM-serving datapath that includes at least Q/K/V, attention score or softmax/reduction, KV-cache read/write, and decode-visible output.
required_artifacts: one active RTL seed target until first success metric
coverage-output word policy for logits/decode-visible output, not raw state
candidate_next_paths.risk: This is likely more RTL work than a CPU-core bridge and still would not prove tokenizer or model-level numerical equivalence.

non_claims: not a real production CPU core
